_doc: Arena 9 (retail world 40: ruins with iron railings) kit for the map editor (S36); it also holds arena 11's (world 42) broken paving, made with the arena 9 broken slabs, same schema as art/arena7/kit.json. The stone reuses the arena 6 loom textures. Pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.
